title: 💦Realistic-Rain RP
description: This resource pack adds a realistic rain effect to the screen.
body:
This resource pack and data pack will add a beautiful rain effect to your world. Unfortunately, the resource pack alone isn't enough; you also need to install the data pack for the effect to appear on your screen.✨

**To enable the effect, go to Settings → Video Settings → Graphics = Fabulous!**
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c57fe9c60ce74708ae87d31a38cd98d1262093a0_0.webp)

To install the datapack into your world.

Go to your world file, to the "datapacks" folder, and paste the datapack there. After a reboot, everything should work.
